title: FaZe Adapt Goes Full Panic Mode After His GTA 6 Driving Mishap
caption: Adapt goes from yelling “oh God” to apologizing on repeat. Then he checks the engine. #FaZeAdapt #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: I say sorry to NPCs too. It's a reflex at this point.
